eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_BOLT.title: Soul Bolt
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_BOLT.flavor: SOUL condensed into a single piercing bolt.

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HUM.title: Hum
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HUM.flavor: The nail hums — one note is enough.

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.title: Hallownest's Echo
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.descriptio: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.flavor: The old kingdom still remembers its guardian.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.title: 圣巢回响
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.descriptio: 消耗 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]。对所有敌人造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNESTS_ECHO.flavor: 古老的国度，仍记得它的守护者。

BoneBreak.reason: 重复的伤害加虚弱职责，保留低费入口。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-BONE_BREAK.title: Bone Break
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-BONE_BREAK.flavor: This swing ends the exchange, not the fight.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-BONE_BREAK.title: 断骨重斩
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-BONE_BREAK.description: 造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害，施加 2 层虚弱。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-BONE_BREAK.flavor: 这一击不为杀敌，只为终结交换。

FragileStrength.reason: 合并同费同稀有度的常驻骨钉增伤。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-FRAGILE_STRENGTH.title: Fragile Strength
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-FRAGILE_STRENGTH.descriptio: Nail attacks deal {FragileStrength:diff()} additional damage. Fragile: whenever you lose HP, lose 1 Fragile Strength.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-FRAGILE_STRENGTH.title: 脆弱之力
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-FRAGILE_STRENGTH.descriptio: 骨钉攻击额外造成 {FragileStrength:diff()} 点伤害。脆弱：每当你失去生命值，失去 1 层脆弱之力。

NailFlurry.reason: 合并 X 费多段骨钉终结技。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_FLURRY.title: Nail Flurry
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_FLURRY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times (X = energy spent).
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_FLURRY.flavor: Nail-shadow falls like rain, and stops only when spent.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_FLURRY.title: 钉乱舞
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_FLURRY.description: 造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害 X 次（X 为打出的能量）。

SporeBreath.reason: 移出独立中毒线，保留防御与法术启动。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.title: Spore Breath
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply {Poison:diff()} Poison to the target.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.flavor: Even a mushroom in the shell has a temper.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.title: 孢子吐息
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.description: 获得 {Block:diff()} 点格挡，对目标施加 {Poison:diff()} 层中毒。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPORE_BREATH.flavor: 甲壳缝隙里的蘑菇，也会有脾气。

Catalyst.reason: 移出独立中毒线，增幅工具回到骨钉。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-CATALYST.title: Catalyst
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-CATALYST.flavor: One drop in the pot, and the whole pot boils.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-CATALYST.title: 催化毒液
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-CATALYST.description: 使目标的中毒层数变为 {Catalyst:diff()} 倍。

DefenderCrest.reason: 移出独立中毒线，保留被动反击能力。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.title: Defender's Crest
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.description: At the end of your turn, apply {DefenderCrest:diff()} Poison to ALL enemies.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.flavor: The guardian's stench keeps all foes at bay.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.title: 守护者纹章
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.description: 回合结束时，对所有敌人施加 {DefenderCrest:diff()} 层中毒。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEFENDER_CREST.flavor: 守护者的气息，无人敢近。

VenomBlade.reason: 移出独立中毒线，保留减益工具。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VENOM_BLADE.title: Venom Blade
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VENOM_BLADE.flavor: The venom on the edge outlasts the hate.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VENOM_BLADE.title: 剧毒之刃
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VENOM_BLADE.description: 对目标施加 {Poison:diff()} 层中毒。

NailEnvenom.reason: 移出独立中毒线，多段收益回到骨钉自身。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ENVENOM.title: Envenomed Nail
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ENVENOM.description: Whenever a Nail attack hits, apply {NailEnvenom:diff()} Poison to the target.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ENVENOM.flavor: An old venom, refined on the nail's tip.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ENVENOM.title: 淬毒之锋
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_ENVENOM.description: 你的骨钉攻击命中时，对目标施加 {NailEnvenom:diff()} 层中毒。

ShellSlam.reason: 移出堆格挡转伤害的独立支线，保留攻防一体牌。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL_SLAM.title: Shell Slam
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL_SLAM.description: Deal damage equal to your current Block.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL_SLAM.flavor: The hardest part makes the sharpest edge.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL_SLAM.title: 壳击
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL_SLAM.description: 造成等同于你当前格挡值的伤害。

Impregnable.reason: 移出永久囤积格挡引擎，保留限时持续防御。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-IMPREGNABLE.title: Impregnable
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-IMPREGNABLE.description: Gain Barricade: your Block no longer expires at the end of your turn.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-IMPREGNABLE.flavor: The shell holds; so does the will.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-IMPREGNABLE.title: 固若金汤
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-IMPREGNABLE.description: 获得壁垒：你的格挡不再于回合结束时消失。

WispAfterimage.reason: 无条件出牌叠甲收束为与消耗牌相关的防御。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.title: After Image
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.description: Whenever you play a card, gain {WispAfterimage:diff()} Block.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.flavor: A shadow of a shadow, still guarding the vessel.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.title: 残像
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.description: 每当你打出一张牌，获得 {WispAfterimage:diff()} 点格挡。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WISP_AFTERIMAGE.flavor: 影子的影子，仍在守护容器。

WraithForm.reason: 移出通用多回合虚影，保留骑士单次闪避。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WRAITH_FORM.title: Wraith Form
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WRAITH_FORM.description: Gain {Wraith:diff()} Wraith: all damage you take is reduced to 1. Lose 1 Wraith at the end of each turn; lose 1 Dexterity at the start of each turn.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WRAITH_FORM.title: 虚影形态
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-WRAITH_FORM.description: 获得 {Wraith:diff()} 层虚影：你受到的所有伤害降至 1 点。每回合结束时失去 1 层虚影；每回合开始时失去 1 点敏捷。

VoidSurge.reason: 无条件力量成长收束为存魂驱动的骨钉增伤。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.title: Void Surge
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.description: At the start of each of your turns, gain {VoidSurge:diff()} Strength.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.flavor: The abyss rises, tide after tide.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.title: 虚空涌动
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.description: 在你的每个回合开始时，获得 {VoidSurge:diff()} 层力量。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_SURGE.flavor: 深渊的潮汐，一浪高过一浪。

Refinement.reason: 移出泛用全牌升级，保留手牌整理工具。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-REFINEMENT.title: Refinement
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-REFINEMENT.description: Upgrade every card in your deck.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-REFINEMENT.flavor: After a hundred forgings, no iron remains common.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-REFINEMENT.title: 百炼升华
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-REFINEMENT.description: 升级你牌组中的所有牌。

VoidFeast.reason: 移出永久生命成长支线，保留法术击杀恢复。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.title: Void Feast
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this kills, permanently gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.flavor: The abyss never sleeps, and is never full.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.title: 虚空吞噬
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.description: 造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害；若击杀敌人，最大生命值永久 +{MaxHp:diff()}。
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_FEAST.flavor: 深渊从不安眠，也从不饱足。

RagingNail.reason: 合并零费骨钉入口，移出自我复制牌。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-RAGING_NAIL.title: Raging Nail
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-RAGING_NAIL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a copy of this card to your discard pile.
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-RAGING_NAIL.flavor: The fury does not rest; neither does the nail.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-RAGING_NAIL.title: 怒斩
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-RAGING_NAIL.description: 造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害；将一张此牌的复制加入你的弃牌堆。

SoulRush.reason: 移出无条件免费加速，资源转换需要灵魂。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_RUSH.title: Soul Rush
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_RUSH.flavor: The instant of an overloaded soul.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_RUSH.title: 魂能激涌
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_RUSH.description: 获得 {Energy:diff()} 点能量，抽 {Draw:diff()} 张牌。

NailShockwave.reason: 合并同费同稀有群攻，保留可产魂的剑技。

eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_SHOCKWAVE.title: Nail Shockwave
eng.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_SHOCKWAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. This attack does not gather SOUL.

zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_SHOCKWAVE.title: 钉气冲击
zhs.HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_SHOCKWAVE.description: 对所有敌人造成 {Damage:diff()} 点伤害。此攻击不产生灵魂。

limitations: No full human playthrough or win-rate measurement
No real multiplayer or mid-combat save test
